customer_name: China Southern Power Grid (南方电网)
business_problem: China Southern Power Grid needed a more elastic and data-rich dispatch architecture to manage fast-growing market complexity, new energy sources, and weather-sensitive grid operations. Its traditional centralized systems were hard to scale, hard to upgrade, and unable to turn years of protected dispatch data into reliable AI and forecasting capabilities.
solution_summary: China Southern Power Grid and Alibaba Cloud transformed the utility's dispatch platform from a concentrated architecture into a distributed cloud foundation and then added a supercomputing layer for AI- and weather-intensive workloads. The dispatch cloud uses multi-region design, unified identity and monitoring, hierarchical operations, and distributed stream, batch, and AI processing so grid data can be modeled instead of sitting idle on disk. On top of that base, the utility built a cloud-native SCADA platform that can expand compute resources in seconds, process more than sixty thousand messages per second, and deploy the whole system in about seventy seconds. In 2021 it also launched the power sector's first dispatch-cloud supercomputing platform on Apsara and Shenlong infrastructure, which gave the grid elastic high-performance compute for fine-grained weather prediction, typhoon response, spot-market clearing, and new-energy power forecasting. The combined platform turns dispatch, forecasting, and market operations into one data-driven AI control plane.

data_flow: Dispatch, market, and operational telemetry is ingested into the distributed dispatch cloud, where streaming, batch, and AI services analyze and model grid behavior. The results feed cloud-native SCADA for real-time operations and the supercomputing layer for heavy tasks such as weather prediction, power-market clearing, and new-energy forecasting before dispatch teams act on the outputs.
business_outcome: The utility raised dispatch accuracy, shortened deployment and scaling cycles, and created a cloud-HPC base for weather and market decisions that directly affect grid reliability and cost. The same platform now supports AI load forecasting, faster market settlement, and more accurate extreme-weather response across a supply area serving hundreds of millions of people.

architecture_clues: The dispatch redesign combines distributed stream, batch, and AI processing instead of adding AI to an unchanged centralized control plane.
SCADA is rebuilt as a cloud-native service with second-level elasticity and extremely high message throughput.
The supercomputing layer is exposed as cloud services so downstream applications do not need to be rewritten to consume HPC capacity.
